questions.prompt: Riya rolls a die 60 times and gets a six 16 times. She says the die is unfair. Explain whether her conclusion is justified.
questions.modelAnswer: Theoretically she would expect about 60 × 1/6 = 10 sixes. 16 is more than expected (experimental probability 16/60 ≈ 0.27 vs 0.17), which could suggest bias, but 60 rolls is a small sample and results naturally vary. She should roll many more times (e.g. 600) before concluding the die is unfair.
rubric: Small sample: needs more trials before concluding
